metadata.question: Did the town of Marovoay have higher water extent in January 27, 2020 than January 18, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Marovoay is a town in Madagascar (approximately -16.3937°, 46.4297°) - I need to compare water extent on two specific dates: January 27, 2020 vs January 18, 2017 - Use Sentinel-2 data (good for water detection) with NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to identify water bodies - Create a geometry around Marovoay (small buffer around the town center) 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA60 band for Sentinel-2 - Calculate NDWI = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) to identify water - Water pixels: NDWI > 0.3 - Count water pixels on both dates to compare water extent 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check if images exist for both dates (size() > 0) - Check pixel counts after cloud masking (count > 0) - If NDWI calculation returns valid values, compare water pixel counts - Valid zero water pixels = no water on that date (answer could be A or B) - Null/NaN = calculation failure (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Marovoay geometry (Madagascar, northwest region) const marovoayCoords = [46.4297, -16.3937]; const point = ee.Geometry.Point(marovoayCoords); const aoi = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around town // 2. Sentinel-2 collection with cloud masking function const maskClouds = function(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask).divide(10000); }; // 3. Get images for January 27, 2020 const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2020-01-25', '2020-01-29') .map(maskClouds); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); print('2020-01-27 Images found: ' + size2020); if (size2020 === 0) { print('C1: No images for 2020-01-27'); return; } // 4. Get images for January 18, 2017 const col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2017-01-16', '2017-01-20') .map(maskClouds); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); print('2017-01-18 Images found: ' + size2017); if (size2017 === 0) { print('C1: No images for 2017-01-18'); return; } // 5. Calculate NDWI for 2020 const img2020 = col2020.median(); const ndwi2020 = img2020.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B11']); const waterMask2020 = ndwi2020.gt(0.3); const waterCount2020 = waterMask2020.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('nd').getInfo(); print('2020-01-27 Water pixels: ' + waterCount2020); // 6. Calculate NDWI for 2017 const img2017 = col2017.median(); const ndwi2017 = img2017.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B11']); const waterMask2017 = ndwi2017.gt(0.3); const waterCount2017 = waterMask2017.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('nd').getInfo(); print('2017-01-18 Water pixels: ' + waterCount2017); // 7. Validation if (waterCount2020 === null || waterCount2017 === null) { print('C3: Calculation failed - null result'); return; } if (waterCount2020 === 0 && waterCount2017 === 0) { print('C2: No valid water pixels in both dates'); return; } // 8. Comparison const comparison = 'Water extent comparison - 2020: ' + waterCount2020 + ', 2017: ' + waterCount2017; print(comparison); if (waterCount2020 > waterCount2017) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
